# nemo_bundle (Data Source)

The versions of a bundle in a registry: its tags that are whole versions, `1.4.0` or `v1.4.0` but not `1.4` nor `latest`, and the latest that matches a constraint, for an installation's `version`. The registry is reached as `docker` reaches it, with the credentials of `docker login`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The latest 1.x of the api bundle, deployed at each apply that finds a newer one.
data "nemo_bundle" "api" {
  repository         = "registry.example.com/shop/api"
  version_constraint = "~> 1.4"
}

resource "nemo_stack" "shop" {
  name   = "shop"
  remote = "docker://registry.example.com/shop/{{ .Component }}:{{ .Version }}"
  target = { orchestrator = "swarm", host = "ssh://deploy@prod-1.example.com" }

  installations = [
    { name = "api", version = data.nemo_bundle.api.version },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repository` (String) The bundle's repository, as an installation's `repository`: `ghcr.io/sntns/whoami`.

### Optional

- `version_constraint` (String) The versions to choose from, as Terraform reads a version constraint: `~> 1.4` or `>= 1.2, < 2`. Default: every version but the pre-releases, which only a constraint that names one matches.

### Read-Only

- `version` (String) The latest version that matches the constraint, as its tag spells it.
- `versions` (List of String) Every version that matches the constraint, from the oldest to the latest, as their tags spell them.
